blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas secured a spot in the quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 men’s U-23 3×3 basketball competition after defeating Kazakhstan, 21-15, on Wednesday. Doy Dungo made crucial baskets in the latter part of the contest as Gilas bucked a slow start to complete a three-game sweep of Group A at King Futo Station Square. Taking a break from his UAAP duties with La Salle to represent Gilas in the halfcourt scene, Dungo scored five of his six points during the final two minutes. Dungo, Nic Cabanero, […]...
